name: vibesdk-agent-harness
description: Control-plane HTTP server that runs inside the harness Fargate task (aws/infra/harness) and wraps the Claude Agent SDK's query() in streaming-input mode as the phased code-generation engine. Built-in mutable tools (Bash/Write/Edit/Read/Glob/Grep) are disabled; custom tools (write_file, read_file, run_command, run_static_analysis, report_phase) proxy to the target sandbox task's aws/sandbox-controlplane server instead, so a runaway agent only costs a disposable sandbox restart.
